headline: Russia warns NATO member Estonia is on the verge of triggering open war
label: NEWS
caption:
Russia has warned that Estonia is on the verge of triggering open war following border closures and rising military tensions. ⚠️

Russia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs accused Estonia of provocative actions after summoning Estonian diplomat Marek Uhtegi in Moscow. The ministry claimed the NATO and EU member state is engaging in hostile behavior that risks direct conflict.

Moscow alleged that Estonia tacitly allowed Ukrainian drones to use its airspace to launch attacks on northwestern Russia. Estonia quickly denied the claim and stated it has never allowed its territory to be used for military operations by another country.

The dispute follows Tallinn's decision to close its border crossings with Russia for at least six months starting December 1. Estonian authorities cited security concerns, while Moscow warned the move would backfire on Estonia and its NATO allies.

NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said the alliance is monitoring the situation and will update its deterrence and defense where necessary.
